messages:
maria: Running the new getting-started sampleapp end-to-end and seeing a spike of 429s immediately after the onboarding credit grant. Happens on the first few batched embed + prompt calls. Repro logs below.

sam: ugh. do you have the logs + is this Hosted or Dedicated?

maria: Hosted. log snippet:
```
2024-04-05T17:45:12Z INFO request id=abc123 status=429 Retry-After: 1
2024-04-05T17:45:12Z ERROR burst: inflight=48 window=256
```

alex: this looks like a client-side prefill + zero-jitter fanout. the quickstart prefill spawns a bunch of warmup calls, and if the server also grants credits or rate-limits, you get a thundering herd. two immediate mitigations: cap prefill concurrency and add jittered backoff that respects Retry-After.

sam: agreed. also noticed SDK parity issue — python default maxInflight=16 but js default=32 in our sampleapp (yikes). that mismatch makes JS sampleapp much more aggressive on first-run.

maria: ah that explains why the JS quickstart hit Hosted harder than python. our docs still show `prefill: 32` as an example.

jen: action items: 1) change sampleapp defaults to safe values for hosted (prefill=8, maxInflight=8), 2) add exponential+full-jitter on 429+respect Retry-After, 3) add a lightweight e2e that simulates credit grant bursts and asserts concurrency <= 10. i'll own docs + sampleapp PR.

sam: proposed JS config snippet for the sampleapp (ready to drop into quickstart):
```js
const client = new RedwoodClient({
  maxInflight: 8,
  prefill: 8,
  retry: {
    maxRetries: 5,
    backoff: attempt => Math.min(1000 * 2**attempt, 5000) + Math.random() * 300,
    respectRetryAfter: true
  }
});
```

alex: also recommend adjusting the pagination example: stream pages (process page N before prefetching N+1) instead of aggressive prefetch of all cursors. link the docs: https://redwood.dev/docs/sdk-pagination — add a short note about backpressure-friendly pagination.

maria: can we include a tiny client helper like `withPrefillGuard(client, {maxInflight})` so sampleapps don't have to copy-paste the same logic?

sam: yes — created GH issue for SDK parity + helper: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk/issues/456 (labels: dx, parity, urgent).

ci-bot: scheduled pipeline `sampleapp/burst-mitigation-test` on branch `devex/burst-mitigate` — running smoke + concurrency assertion :white_check_mark:

jen: thanks, team. i'll follow up with the PR and update quickstart snippets. tagging @sam @alex for review.

maria: :thumbsup: pushing a staging deploy with the change now, will report results in ~10m.

sam: :eyes: if staging looks good let's roll to production with a temporary rate-cap in the sampleapp until SDK parity lands.
